start_gate: the frozen 288-cell comparison and all replays must finish first; serial execution only
depth_reason: largest eligible depth in [0,1,2,4] from allocation preflight 3dac93c3; no retained-model heldout results
feature_bank: all complete paths of lengths zero through maximum depth; depth, then view, then path order
initializer: empirical frequency proposals; minimum CE versus first channel below the declared vocabulary-calibrated threshold, otherwise minimum CE; charge all training labels
first_channel_ce_threshold: log(1+(vocab-1)*exp(-24)) + 1e-8, the proved pure-proposal CE plus a fixed tolerance
minibatch_examples: original task batch, seed-1 example shuffle, retain tail and all supervised positions
primary_pass: original selected split exact sequences >= 99 percent
all_splits_pass: every original nontraining split exact sequences >= 99 percent
cache_policy: retain every cache and model; verify every cached row against original inputs in replay and retain hashes and byte counts
scope: 48 retained joint heads; prior independent/additive/final-depth controls remain separate frozen evidence; fresh matched transformer and whole-35 recovery remain separate
